title.narrative: Strengthening the competitiveness of the cassava value chain in Kenya

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening the competitiveness of the cassava value chain in Kenya - This programme has two main goals: poverty reduction and improvement of nutritional status. It aims at developing: a) inclusive and sustainable agriculture based value chains one side and b) food fortification on the other.
